description: Land Acquisition - Moronthuduwa and Mawala, Kaluthara D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific lots of land being acquired by the government for a public purpose. It contains descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, and claimant information, which falls squarely under the "Land and property-related matters" category (Type 4). There is no government personnel/structure content or any other specialized category that takes precedence.
